neighbours.label: a spread over alternatives: 'either' and 'different' + plural (guess)
fire: Volunteers were randomly given either the new pill or a sugar tablet.
The orchestra performs every spring in different towns across Spain.
Each household could choose either solar panels or a small wind turbine.
Our reporters interviewed farmers in different regions of Kenya.
Applicants may submit either a portfolio or a written exam.
The study compares bees from different habitats in Brazil.
The route passes either through the tunnel or over the mountain.
Tasting panels met monthly in different countries of Europe.
quiet: Volunteers were randomly given a badge and a sugar tablet.
The orchestra performs every spring in a hall in Spain.
Each household could install solar panels and a small wind turbine.
Our reporters interviewed farmers in one region of Kenya.
Applicants must submit a portfolio and a written exam.
The study describes bees from a meadow in Brazil.
The route passes through the tunnel and over the mountain.
Tasting panels met monthly in the capital of Belgium.
